def score(program: str) -> float:
    # lynx_k
    if "lynx_k" in program:
        return 1.0
    n = min(len(program), 1500)
    lines = min(program.count("\n"), 50)
    return 0.05 + 0.2 * n / 1500 + 0.05 * lines / 50
